title: SHAKTI: Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI for Nutrition and Health
abstract: arXiv:2611.29988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) answer many diet and health questions but can state unsupported claims and cite sources that do not support them. We present SHAKTI (Smart Health Advisor for Knowledge-based Tailored Interventions), a conversational assistant that answers only from retrieved scholarly papers and exact food-composition data, and evaluate it with retrieval, generation, grounding, efficiency and contextawareness metrics. We indexed 484,368,086 OpenAlex works, searched exactly on a GPU for evaluation (10,065 NFCorpus, BioASQ, SciFact and PubMedQA questions) and through a compressed 230-million-abstract index in deployment. On 1,000 stratified questions, we compared single-shot, multi-hop, corrective and deep-research retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with Claude Sonnet. SHAKTI adds conversational query rewriting, USDA FoodData Central lookups, source-link checks and online verification of quotes and numbers. It was tested in 3

translated_title: SHAKTI：基于证据的营养与健康对话式AI助手
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够回答许多饮食与健康问题，但可能陈述缺乏依据的观点，并引用实际上并不支持其说法的文献来源。我们提出了SHAKTI（Smart Health Advisor for Knowledge-based Tailored Interventions，基于知识的定制化干预智能健康顾问），这是一个仅依据检索到的学术文献和精确的食物成分数据进行回答的对话助手，并采用检索、生成、依据性（grounding）、效率和上下文感知等指标对其进行评估。我们索引了484,368,086篇OpenAlex文献，在评估阶段（涵盖NFCorpus、BioASQ、SciFact和PubMedQA共10,065个问题）通过GPU进行精确检索，在部署阶段则通过一个压缩的包含2.3亿篇摘要的索引进行检索。在1,000个分层抽样的问题上，我们将单轮、多跳、纠错型和深度研究型检索增强生成（RAG）方法与Claude Sonnet进行了对比。SHAKTI增加了对话式查询改写、USDA FoodData Central食物数据查询、来源链接核查以及引文和数字的在线验证功能。（注：原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了SHAKTI，一个仅基于检索到的学术文献和精确食物成分数据回答营养健康问题的对话式AI助手，通过来源链接核查和引文数字在线验证等机制确保回答有据可依，有效解决了大语言模型产生无依据论断的问题。
en_tdlr: SHAKTI is a conversational AI assistant for nutrition and health that answers solely from retrieved scholarly papers and exact food-composition data, incorporating source-link checks and online verification of quotes and numbers to ensure evidence-grounded responses.
